subject.title: [Bug]: tool-status footer renders heredoc body lines as phantom failed commands (splitTopLevelStages ignores heredocs)

question: Should OpenClaw land a helper-level heredoc-aware `scanTopLevelChars` fix, or treat the current exec-summary compaction as sufficient for this issue?
rationale: Current main masks the main footer path, but the exported splitter helper still has the reported behavior and two open closing PRs compete for the same boundary.

options.title: Land one canonical helper fix
options.body: Review and land the best heredoc-aware scanner implementation, then close the duplicate or weaker PRs after the issue is fixed.

options.title: Declare display compaction sufficient
options.body: Close the helper-level PRs and this issue if maintainers decide no caller should rely on direct heredoc-aware stage splitting.

recommendation.title: Land one canonical helper fix
recommendation.body: Review and land the best heredoc-aware scanner implementation, then close the duplicate or weaker PRs after the issue is fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current shell display parser split and is the strongest history signal for the helper boundary decision.
